newsitem.title: UK: C&W gets $1.18 bln from HK Telecom share sale.
newsitem.headline: C&W gets $1.18 bln from HK Telecom share sale.

text.p: Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc said on Wednesday it received $1.18 billion from the sale of a 5.5 percent in its Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd unit to China Telecom (Hong Kong) Ltd.
The sum was in line with the amount C&W said it would receive from the Chinese state-owned company when the deal was unveiled in June.
Following the sale of the 644 million shares, C&W said it owned 6.45 billion shares in Hong Kong Telecommunications, representing some 54.2 percent of the share capital.
As part of its deal with China Telecom, C&W will sell its Hong Kong Telecom stake down to 30 percent in return for growth opportunities on the Chinese mainland.
